verdict.rationale: Extend's evidence documents AI extraction, classification, splitting, parsing, and per-field confidence scores. Those return structured data, not in-product insights or suggestions about the user's data. 'Composer & Review Agent' appears only as a bare pricing-page label with no description of generating insights or recommendations. The axis applies to an AI document platform, but there is no documented evidence it delivers this.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
